name: P1 pool time-model + split-K model + operand traffic (current contract)
code:
def score(f, p, hw, w):
    # Time model (pool): busiest-SM compute path, L2->SM feed (re-priced by kappa = w[0]) and DRAM feed overlap as a p=2 norm.
    t = np.sqrt(np.square(f.tm_crit_ratio) + np.square(w[0] * f.tm_l2_ratio) + np.square(f.tm_dram_ratio))
    s = 10.0 * np.log2(t)
    # Efficiency the norm cannot see: register-staged 2-stage mainloop, CTA-wide barrier over more warps.
    s = s + w[1] * f.tm_regstaged + w[2] * f.tm_cta_warps
    # Split-K time model with an interior optimum (fill/epilogue per round, serial fix-up at DRAM), in log2 time.
    s = s + w[3] * f.splitk_roofline_log_time
    # L2->SM operand traffic over compulsory bytes (small tiles thrash the 6 MB L2).
    s = s + w[4] * np.log2(f.operand_tile_traffic_ratio)
    # Tie-break among raster variants that differ only in inst_total: raster along the shorter grid side.
    if p.M > p.N:
        s = s + w[5] * 0.001 * f.tm_log_inst
    else:
        s = s + w[6] * 0.001 * f.tm_log_inst
    return s
